venue.name: Osteria Nove, Leeds
venue.policy: Cancel up to the free window before your booking and your deposit comes back in full. A later cancellation is excused, and the deposit refunded, if you or someone in your party is ill or injured, if a train or flight you were booked on is cancelled, or if a severe weather warning advises against travel. A change of plans, a better offer elsewhere, or forgetting is not excused.
